stemMd: Choose the version that correctly uses a possessive for a single gardener.

options.label: A
options.textMd: The gardener's gloves were drying on the fence.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The gardeners' gloves were drying on the fence.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The gardener gloves' were drying on the fence.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The gardeners gloves were drying on the fence.

explanationMd: The gloves belong to one gardener. Add apostrophe-s to the singular noun gardener to mark that possession.

distractorRationale.c: The apostrophe is incorrectly attached to gloves.
distractorRationale.d: No apostrophe marks the intended singular possession.
distractorRationale.b: This marks possession by multiple gardeners rather than the specified one.
